title: AIP Morning Brief — Trailer: what this show is
show_notes: **Trailer.** What The AIP Morning Brief covers: client capex signals, competitors, macro and SaaS benchmarks, scored by confidence with base, best and worst cases — and three things to raise with the CFO every morning.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: Welcome to The AIP Morning Brief. Every morning, in under ten minutes, we cover the news that moves asset investment planning: utility rate cases, regulators, infrastructure funding, competitors, and the macro backdrop.

dialogue.speaker: STRATEGIST
dialogue.text: And I'm here to tell you what it actually means for the numbers. Every story gets a confidence rating, and the strong ones get a base case, a best case and a worst case.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: We finish every episode with three things worth raising with the CFO that day.

dialogue.speaker: STRATEGIST
dialogue.text: Short, sharp, and opinionated where the evidence earns it. See you tomorrow morning.
